sections.title: Sound of the letter
paragraphs: The letter is named (Te) /teː/. Its main sound is heard in (Tisch) /tɪʃ/, which means table. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Press your tongue tip against the ridge behind your upper teeth. Stop the air completely, then release it with a small puff of breath. The voice is off, so your throat does not shake. For the other sound, press your tongue in the same place and release the air softly without any puff. Hold your hand before your mouth to feel the breath.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: Before a stressed vowel, you say the sound with a puff of air, as in (Tag) /tʰaːk/. After an s sound, in an unstressed syllable, or in a consonant cluster, you say it without a puff of air, as in (Stein) /ʃtaɪ̯n/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not replace the sound between vowels with a tap, like the quick middle sound in water. Keep the stop clean and voiceless, like the sound in top. Do not let your tongue touch your teeth.
